headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of September 25, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 28.35% compared to SPY's 13.75%. This translates to an average alpha of 14.61%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', shows a significant return of 47.20%, driven largely by its top holding, PANW, which has returned 144.66%. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 11.48%, highlighting the variability within the portfolio set. This outperformance is particularly noteworthy during a period of broader market uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's relative strength. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
